messages.subject: SAEM
parts:
Hi Phil,

I would like to know if the SAEM (Stochastic Approximation EM, ) algorithm is available in the mirt package.

Thanks a lot in advance,

Caio

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: SAEM
parts:
The SAEM is just a special application of the MHRM, so yes it is available as well with some tweaks to the optimizer specifications. 

Phil
